identityAssessment.finding: The imported feature lies on the Sinaloa coast, approximately 108.38 to 107.35 degrees west and 24.25 to 25.38 degrees north, consistent with the coastal Achire subject. Neither the polygon nor its 1492 boundary is independently verified.

scopeNotes: Guasave and Achire are not merged into one people even when a source discusses them together.
The 2019 article repeats older regional descriptions and is not counted as an independent archaeological discovery.
No securely attributed excavated Achire object was established in this research. Documented weaving and raft construction are described with their evidence type explicit.
Guayabay and Guayabal are retained in the respective authors’ accounts; their equivalence and exact historical location are not silently asserted.
Later community history remains unresolved; uncertainty is limited to the sources checked, not declared unknowable.
